notes.title: Hotloop v1.3 update and 61% discount from April 11 in honor of Cosmonautics Day!
notes.content:
- Removed the third orbit from the tutorial
- Fixed enemy spawning in close proximity to the player
- Improved behavior of the unguided missile
- Improved behavior of the guided missile
- Enemies can no longer lie on the planet
- Fixed one of the possible causes of the ship turning over when taking off from the planet
- Added display of the correct buttons in accordance with the active input device
- Improved display of the currently selected interface element when navigating with a gamepad
- Improved visibility of the aiming reticle
- Improved behavior and efficiency of the EMP module
- Fixed damage of the "blowfisher" module to allied buildings
- Now loot disappears over time and does not interfere with the view
- Fixed display of information about the weapon / module over the cursor
- Added the ability to select the output monitor
- Added the ability to select the window display mode
- Added the ability to select the image resolution
- Added some graphics settings
- Fixed the display of the current level and points after save\load
- Fixed incorrect restart of the "The Hole" level
- Improved display of damage numbers
- Improved engine sound during minor maneuvers
- Fixed untimely issuance of the "Rocket League" achievement
- Fixed dropping of two experience cards of different levels as a reward for completing a round
- Flamethrower now sets fire to the victim
- Added information about the required points to unlock the level
- Adjusted the characteristics of some modules
- Fixed the drop of the turret repair card
- Fixed rounding of module characteristics
- Fixed invisible obstacle for beam guns
- "Bastion" no longer saves from falling into the sun
- Fixed the starting line at the "Hole" level
- Improved navigation in the settings menu
- Fixed untimely issuance of the "Mama ama engineer" achievement
- Fixed receiving the "Hard Landing" achievement for docking to a station
- Improved font in the settings window
- Improved display of long inscriptions in the settings window
- Improved shadow quality in some locations
- Fixed flickering special effects at startup when using vulkan

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43379247/3218f68fdfda6f4c4dace36fb4f6799ee0ea1e1c.png[/img]

List of changes:
- reworked right stick aiming
- improved gamed\steam deck UI navigation

- improved explosions special effects

notes.title: Martian turret outposts update
notes.content:
[h1]MARTIAN TURRET OUTPOSTS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43379247/9376ce24e6bf525727e1cadadc6ed76985b98226.gif[/img]

Now the most powerful weapons are located on the Martian moons!

No enemy can survive a hit from a  Super Turret 40k!

Defend these posts, don't let enemies get closer and repair turrets on time!

[h2]Update inlcudes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Supper Turret 40k helping player to deal with enemies on "Mars" location
[*] improved Super shield enable VFX visibility
[*] improved trajectory visibility
[*] reduced fuel storage volume (yes it makes game little harder)
[*] increased "Polaris" weapon power

[/list]
